chapter: Fisher's band and Jack Laine's bands
title: Funerals with Fisher and Jack Laine
summary: Brunies describes playing funerals to the graveyard, with jazz on the way back, at about age 21, with both Fisher's band and Jack Laine, and a funeral and communion party for the mayor's family.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
